'''Passenger Walkers''' were a model of [[Walker/Legends|walker]] commonly used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Emmer]]. Passenger Walkers were variants of the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]], equipped with banks of windows along the sides and were painted in bright colors. Passenger Walkers were used for tourism and mass transit.<ref name="E" />
